ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Scheduled Task Creation Involving Temp Folder
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the creation of scheduled tasks that involves a temporary folder and runs only once

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\schtasks\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/create\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/sc\\ once\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Temp\\\\.*")))
